newsitem.title: USA: Robotic Vision wins round in patent fight.
newsitem.headline: Robotic Vision wins round in patent fight.

text.p: Robotic Vision Systems Inc said Tuesday that the U.S. Court of Appeals in Washington, D.C., had unanimously reversed a ruling by a federal trial judge in California that had invalidated one of its patents.

The company said that in 1995 it had sued View Engineering, since acquired by General Scanning Inc, for infringing a patented method of using a three-dimensional sensor to inspect the leads of integrated circuit chips.

It lost that case, but with the new ruling will be able to again bring the suit to trial before the California judge. The company said it will vigorously pursue its claims in the matter. It also said that if its position were upheld, it believes that View Engineering would be unable to develop a comparable product that would be competitive.
Representatives from General Scanning and View were not immediately available for comment.
Robotic makes 2-D and 3-D machine vision based systems for inspection, measurement, and identification, utilizing advanced electro-optical sensor technology.
